title: Safety on board
instructions: Uçakta kabin ekibinin güvenlik anonsu. Kuralları ve sayıları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome on board flight BA 207 to Lisbon.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: Our flight time today is two hours and forty minutes.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: Please put your bags in the lockers above your seat or under the seat in front of you.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: There are six emergency exits: two at the front, two in the middle and two at the back.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: Please keep your seatbelt on while you are sitting down.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the plane, including the toilets.

script.speaker: crew
script.text: We will serve drinks and snacks in about thirty minutes. Hot meals are available to buy.

questions.evidence: welcome on board flight BA 207 to Lisbon.

questions.feedback: Uçuş süresi iki saat kırk dakika.
questions.evidence: Our flight time today is two hours and forty minutes.

questions.prompt: How many emergency exits are there?
questions.feedback: Altı acil çıkış var: önde, ortada ve arkada ikişer.

questions.prompt: When should passengers wear their seatbelt?
options: only when the light is on

questions.prompt: What is free on this flight?
